# Local changes to MarkdownEngine

Base: upstream tag 0.16.0 (see `UPSTREAM`). Every change is marked with a `// mlisb:` comment.
To see the full diff: `diff -ru <upstream checkout>/Sources Sources`.

| Change | Files |
|---|---|
| Overlay scroller always (no legacy scroller with a track) | `TextView/ClampedScrollView.swift` |
| `DiagramRenderer` service: fenced blocks drawn as images, source shown when the caret is inside | `Services/MarkdownEditorServices.swift`, `Styling/MarkdownStyler+Diagrams.swift` (new), `Styling/MarkdownStyler.swift`, `TextView/NativeTextViewWrapper.swift` |
| `NativeTextViewWrapper.onOpenLink: ((String) -> Bool)?`: markdown links and bare URLs offered to the embedder with the raw target; `true` = handled | `TextView/NativeTextViewWrapper.swift`, `TextView/Coordinator/NativeTextViewCoordinator.swift`, `TextView/Coordinator/NativeTextViewCoordinator+TextDelegate.swift` |
| `ListStyle.arrowReplacementEnabled` (default true): opt out of the `->` to `→` rewrite | `Configuration/MarkdownEditorConfiguration.swift`, `Input/MarkdownListHandler.swift` |
| `MarkdownEditorConfiguration.revealAllSyntax` (default false): styled source mode, every construct treated as active; runtime flip restyles in place | `Configuration/MarkdownEditorConfiguration.swift`, `Styling/MarkdownASTStyler.swift`, `Parser/MarkdownDetection.swift`, `TextView/Coordinator/NativeTextViewCoordinator+Restyling.swift`, `TextView/NativeTextViewWrapper.swift` |
| External `text` replace for the same `documentId` keeps selection (clamped) and scroll; rebuild now clamps a restored selection instead of dropping it | `TextView/NativeTextViewWrapper.swift`, `TextView/Coordinator/NativeTextViewCoordinator+Restyling.swift` |
| List continuation lines (hard-wrapped item text) take the item's text indent; their source indentation collapses | `Styling/MarkdownASTStyler.swift` |
| Fenced code, all valid forms: `~~~`, 4+ char fences (closer at least as long, same char), up to 3 spaces of indent, inside list items (indent 4+ under a list item) and blockquotes (`> ` prefix); prefixes stripped from the code, highlighting and the diagram hook work for each. Block window widens over indented blocks so incremental == full; adjacent quotes/lists re-merge. **Deliberate difference from the spec:** a fence with no closer stays ordinary text (typing an opening fence must not turn the rest of the document into code). Also: a backtick fence's info string may not contain a backtick (spec) | `Parser/FenceScanner.swift` (new), `Parser/BlockParser.swift`, `Parser/BlockLevelTokenizer.swift`, `Parser/BlockScopedTokenizer.swift`, `Parser/MarkdownTokenizer.swift`, `Styling/MarkdownASTStyler.swift`, `Styling/MarkdownStyler+Diagrams.swift`, `Renderer/MarkdownHTMLRenderer.swift`, `TextView/Coordinator/NativeTextViewCoordinator+TextDelegate.swift`, `+CodeBlocks.swift` |
| Alerts: a blockquote opening with a lone `[!NOTE]`/`TIP`/`IMPORTANT`/`WARNING`/`CAUTION` line gets a bar in the alert's dynamic system colour (new `.blockquoteBarColor`) and a bold title drawn over the hidden marker text (new `.alertTitle`, painted by the layout fragment); marker text shows with the caret on that line. HTML export: `<div class="markdown-alert markdown-alert-note">` | `Styling/MarkdownASTStyler+GFM.swift` (new), `Styling/MarkdownASTStyler.swift`, `Renderer/MarkdownTextLayoutFragment.swift`, `Renderer/MarkdownHTMLRenderer.swift` |
| Setext headings: paragraph lines over a `===` (H1) / `---` (H2) underline (3+ characters, a subset of the spec's 1+) become a heading styled like the ATX one; the underline is dimmed and small away from the caret. A `---` after a blank line stays a thematic break. New `BlockKind.setextHeading`, projected as `BlockNode.heading` with the underline as its only marker. Incremental parse: rule lines force a full parse, and a paragraph at the window edge re-merges with a following setext block | `Parser/BlockParser.swift`, `Parser/MarkdownAST.swift`, `Parser/BlockLevelTokenizer.swift`, `Styling/MarkdownASTStyler.swift`, `Styling/MarkdownASTStyler+GFM.swift`, `TextView/Coordinator/NativeTextViewCoordinator+TextDelegate.swift` |
| Front matter: `---` first line to the next `---` line at offset 0 is one opaque block (`BlockKind.frontMatter` / `BlockNode.frontMatter`), drawn monospaced and dimmed with no markdown inside; source always shown. `computeBlocks(atDocumentStart:)` keeps a mid-document reparse window from opening one | `Parser/BlockParser.swift`, `Parser/MarkdownAST.swift`, `Parser/BlockScopedTokenizer.swift`, `Parser/BlockLevelTokenizer.swift`, `Styling/MarkdownASTStyler.swift`, `Styling/MarkdownASTStyler+GFM.swift`, `Renderer/MarkdownHTMLRenderer.swift` |
| Tables without outer pipes: `a \| b` over a `---\|---` delimiter row (needs a pipe, and as many header cells as delimiter columns); body rows are any pipe-containing line that does not start another block (a deliberate narrowing of the spec, which takes pipe-less lines as rows). Outer-piped tables are unchanged. Cell splitting and alignment already handled missing outer pipes. Incremental parse: a table reaching the window end forces a full parse (it takes following rows) | `Parser/BlockParser.swift`, `Parser/BlockLevelTokenizer.swift` |

Tests: `Tests/MarkdownEngineTests/MlisbPatchTests.swift`.

Known upstream test failure on macOS 27 (not caused by these changes):
`MarkdownHTMLRendererTests` "bare URLs and emails autolink" (`www.example.com`).
